Definition: Salcah, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Salcah was a city on the edge of Bashan, named as the far border of Og's kingdom and of the land given to the half tribe of Manasseh. It sits in the lists that map out the conquest, marking how far east Israel's inheritance ran.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God sets real borders for His people, and Salcah is one of the markers that shows where the promise reached.
